title: Mobile Collection Services: Booking Time for Home Recollections
content:
When the specimen on a Laboratory Test Orders accession was collected in the patient's home, the recollection window is lengthened to allow a home recollection to be booked. The visit concerned is the Halverson collection visit recorded for the accession with the status *collected* in Specimen Collection Appointments.

| Collection visit recorded for the accession | Homebound status on the visit | Recollection window lengthened by |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Certified Medicare homebound | 10 days |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Not homebound | 5 days |
| Any other collection | — | none |

**Clause.** When the Halverson collection visit recorded for the accession is a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and its homebound status is certified Medicare homebound, the recollection window is lengthened by 10 days for booking the home recollection. When that visit is a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and its homebound status is not homebound, the recollection window is lengthened by 5 days. Any other collection receives no home-visit lengthening.

**Cases (hypothetical).**

1. A specimen collected at a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit for a patient certified as Medicare homebound: 10 days.
2. A specimen collected at a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit for a patient who is not homebound: 5 days.
3. A specimen collected at a Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit: no home-visit lengthening.
4. A specimen with no collected Halverson visit recorded for the accession: no home-visit lengthening.
